theorems.name: Submission.lipschitzImage_iSup_pieceCount_eq_fiberCount
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (f : X → Y) (P : ℕ → ℕ → Set X), (∀ i j k, j ≠ k → Disjoint (P i j) (P i k)) → (∀ i, ⋃ j, P i j = Set.univ) → (∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ P i j, ∀ x' ∈ P i j, dist x x' < 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) → (∀ i j, ∃ k, P (i + 1) j ⊆ P i k) → ∀ y : Y, Monotone (fun i ↦ ∑' j, (f '' (A ∩ P i j)).indicator (1 : Y → ℝ≥0∞) y) ∧ ⨆ i, ∑' j, (f '' (A ∩ P i j)).indicator (1 : Y → ℝ≥0∞) y = fiberCount A f y
